name: ChEMBL
modality: small-molecule bioactivity tables (relational)
description: Manually curated database of bioactive molecules with drug-like properties: compounds, targets, assays and measured activities (IC50, Ki, ...), drug mechanisms and indications, taken from the literature and deposited sets.
format: PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite dumps, SDF, FASTA, RDF; REST API

licence.claim: CC-BY-SA-3.0
licence.pattern: Creative Commons Attribution-Share ?Alike 3\.0 Unported

notes: Share-alike: a database built from ChEMBL data must keep the same licence.

name: PubChem (Compound, Substance)
modality: chemical structures, identifiers and properties
description: Open chemistry database of the US National Library of Medicine: substances deposited by hundreds of sources, standardised compounds, properties, synonyms, patents and literature links.
format: SDF, ASN.1, XML, JSON, CSV; PUG REST and PUG View APIs; FTP

licence.claim: NCBI data usage policy: NCBI places no restrictions on use or distribution; submitters may hold rights
licence.pattern: places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data

notes: Each depositor keeps its own terms; PubChem shows them per data source. PUG REST is disallowed in robots.txt for crawlers, so this catalogue did not call it.

name: PubChem BioAssay
modality: screening results: one table per assay (AID)
description: Biological test results for small molecules and RNAi: high-throughput screens (including the NIH Molecular Libraries Program and Tox21), dose-response data and literature-derived activities, each with a protocol description.
format: CSV, JSON, XML, ASN.1; PUG REST; FTP

licence.claim: NCBI data usage policy: NCBI places no restrictions on use or distribution; submitters may hold rights
licence.pattern: places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data

notes: Depositor terms apply per assay. PUG REST is disallowed in robots.txt for crawlers, so this catalogue did not call it.

name: BindingDB
modality: protein-ligand binding affinities (tabular)
description: Measured binding affinities (Ki, Kd, IC50, EC50) between proteins considered drug targets and small, drug-like molecules, curated from journals and patents.
format: TSV, SDF; REST web services

licence.claim: CC-BY-3.0-US
licence.pattern: Creative Commons Attribution 3\.0 (United States )?License|creativecommons\.org/licenses/by/3\.0/us

name: Therapeutics Data Commons (TDC)
modality: machine-learning-ready tables for therapeutics tasks
description: Collection of curated datasets and benchmark groups for drug discovery machine learning: ADME, toxicity, high-throughput screens, drug-target interaction, drug response, synergy, antibodies, generation and retrosynthesis. Single datasets are listed as tdc:* entries.
format: CSV, TSV and pickle files on Harvard Dataverse; Python package PyTDC

licence.claim: Varies by dataset (see the tdc:* entries); the PyTDC code is MIT

name: MoleculeNet
modality: benchmark tables of molecules (SMILES) with labels
description: Benchmark collection for molecular machine learning: ESOL, FreeSolv, Lipophilicity, BBBP, Tox21, ToxCast, SIDER, ClinTox, HIV, BACE, MUV, PCBA, QM7, QM8, QM9 and PDBbind subsets, loaded through DeepChem.
format: CSV, SDF; DeepChem loaders

licence.unverified: no single licence; DeepChem code is MIT and each dataset keeps the terms of its original source

notes: The old site moleculenet.org no longer answers; the DeepChem documentation is the current reference.

name: ZINC20 / ZINC22
modality: purchasable compounds: 2D SMILES and 3D docking-ready structures
description: Free database of commercially available compounds prepared for virtual screening, with purchasability, physical properties and ready-to-dock 3D formats. ZINC22 adds billions of make-on-demand molecules.
format: SMILES, SDF, mol2, DOCK flexibase; tranche downloads

licence.claim: ZINC terms: free to use for everyone; redistribution of significant subsets needs written permission
licence.pattern: free to use for everyone

name: DrugBank Open Data (vocabulary and open structures)
modality: drug identifiers, names, synonyms and structures
description: The public-domain part of DrugBank: DrugBank identifiers with names, CAS numbers, UNII, synonyms and InChIKeys, and structures of drugs. The full DrugBank database is not part of this entry.
format: CSV, SDF

licence.pattern: CC0 1\.0|Creative Common.{0,3}s CC0

notes: The full DrugBank database is CC BY-NC 4.0 for academic use only, needs an approved account, and is left out of this catalogue.

name: Open Targets Platform
modality: target-disease evidence and annotation tables
description: Integrated evidence that links drug targets to diseases: genetic associations, somatic mutations, known drugs, expression, pathways, literature mining and animal models, with association scores, plus target, disease and drug annotation.
format: Parquet and JSON on FTP, Google Cloud and BigQuery; GraphQL API

licence.pattern: CC0 1\.0|Creative Commons Public Domain Dedication|creativecommons\.org/publicdomain/zero

name: Protein Data Bank (wwPDB archive, RCSB PDB)
modality: experimental 3D structures of macromolecules and ligands
description: The single worldwide archive of experimentally determined 3D structures of proteins, nucleic acids and complexes with ligands (X-ray, cryo-EM, NMR), with experimental data and the Chemical Component Dictionary.
format: mmCIF, PDB, BinaryCIF, PDBML; REST and GraphQL APIs

licence.pattern: CC0 1\.0 Universal

notes: The RCSB data API is disallowed in robots.txt for crawlers, so this catalogue did not call it.

name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database
modality: predicted 3D protein structures with confidence scores
description: Predicted structures for over 200 million UniProt sequences from AlphaFold, with per-residue confidence (pLDDT) and predicted aligned error; bulk archives per model organism proteome and for Swiss-Prot.
format: mmCIF, PDB, JSON (PAE); bulk tar archives; REST API

licence.claim: CC-BY-4.0
licence.pattern: CC[- ]BY[- ]4\.0|Creative Commons Attribution 4\.0

name: PDBbind
modality: protein-ligand complex structures with binding affinities
description: Experimentally measured binding affinities for biomolecular complexes in the PDB, with processed structure files; the usual training and test set for scoring functions (general, refined and core sets).
format: PDB, mol2, SDF, index tables

licence.unverified: a provider licence that needs a registered account; recent releases have commercial terms

notes: Needs a registered account. Open alternatives are in this catalogue: BindingDB, BioLiP, PLINDER, PoseBusters.

name: BioLiP
modality: biologically relevant ligand-protein interactions from the PDB
description: Semi-manually curated database of biologically relevant ligand-protein binding interactions: binding site residues, ligand type, affinity where known, catalytic sites and function annotation, updated weekly from the PDB.
format: tab-separated annotation files, PDB-format receptor and ligand files

licence.claim: BioLiP: all data are freely available (no licence named)
licence.pattern: all data from the BioLiP database are freely available

name: PLINDER
modality: protein-ligand interaction systems with splits for machine learning
description: Large annotated set of protein-ligand complexes from the PDB with quality annotations, similarity clusters and leakage-aware train and test splits for docking and co-folding models.
format: mmCIF, SDF, Parquet index; Google Cloud bucket; Python package

licence.claim: Apache-2.0
licence.pattern: Apache License\s+Version 2\.0

notes: The licence file read here is the one in the PLINDER code repository.

name: Tox21 (Toxicology in the 21st Century)
modality: quantitative high-throughput screening results
description: US federal programme that tested about 10,000 chemicals in nuclear receptor and stress response assays. Results are deposited in PubChem and shown in the Tox21 data browser; the Tox21 Data Challenge 2014 subset is a common benchmark.
format: CSV, SDF, PubChem assay tables

name: ToxCast (invitroDB)
modality: in vitro assay results with concentration-response fits
description: US EPA high-throughput screening data for thousands of chemicals across hundreds of assay endpoints, released as the invitroDB database with summary files and the tcpl processing pipeline.
format: MySQL dump, CSV summary files

name: SIDER (Side Effect Resource)
modality: drug - side effect pairs with frequencies
description: Side effects of marketed medicines mined from package inserts, mapped to MedDRA terms, with frequency information and indications. Version 4.1 is the last release.
format: TSV
notes: The site's robots.txt blocks AI agents, so no page of it was read.

name: FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) quarterly files
modality: spontaneous adverse event reports (tabular)
description: Quarterly extracts of adverse event and medication error reports sent to the FDA: demographics, drugs, reactions (MedDRA terms), outcomes, report sources and indications. The same reports are served as JSON by openFDA (openfda:drug/event).
format: ASCII (dollar-delimited) and XML, zipped per quarter

licence.claim: Public domain (FDA website policy: content is not copyrighted unless noted)
licence.pattern: not copyrighted.{0,200}public domain|public domain.{0,200}may be republished

notes: Reaction terms are coded in MedDRA, which has its own licence.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov
modality: registered clinical studies with protocols and results (structured text)
description: Registry of clinical studies run in over 200 countries: design, conditions, interventions, eligibility, outcomes, sponsors, status and, for many completed trials, summary results.
format: JSON, CSV; REST API v2; bulk zip of all studies

licence.unverified: public registry data with attribution conditions (ClinicalTrials.gov terms and conditions)

notes: The terms page is script-driven and could not be read by this script. The API path is disallowed in robots.txt for crawlers, so this catalogue did not call it.

name: AACT (Aggregate Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov)
modality: relational copy of ClinicalTrials.gov
description: Relational database with every study registered in ClinicalTrials.gov, refreshed daily by the Clinical Trials Transformation Initiative; easier for SQL analysis than the registry's own API.
format: PostgreSQL dump, pipe-delimited flat files; free account for the cloud database

name: DrugCentral
modality: approved drugs with targets, indications and pharmacology (relational)
description: Online drug compendium: active ingredients, chemical structures, regulatory approval, mechanism-of-action targets, indications, pharmacologic class, FAERS signal summaries and product labels.
format: PostgreSQL dump, TSV, SDF; API

licence.claim: CC-BY-SA-4.0
licence.pattern: CC BY-SA 4\.0|Attribution-ShareAlike 4\.0|creativecommons\.org/licenses/by-sa/4\.0

name: IUPHAR/BPS Guide to PHARMACOLOGY (GtoPdb)
modality: expert-curated targets, ligands and their interactions
description: Expert-curated quantitative data on drug targets (GPCRs, ion channels, nuclear receptors, enzymes, transporters) and the approved and experimental ligands that act on them, with selectivity and affinity.
format: CSV, TSV, PostgreSQL dump, SDF, RDF; REST web services

patterns: Open Data Commons Open Database License

notes: The database is under ODbL and its contents under CC BY-SA 4.0: both are share-alike.

name: Open Reaction Database (ORD)
modality: structured records of chemical reactions
description: Open-access schema and repository for organic reaction data: reactants, conditions, procedures and outcomes, including patent-derived reactions and high-throughput experimentation sets.
format: Protocol buffer records (gzipped), Python client

licence.claim: CC-BY-SA-4.0
licence.pattern: Attribution-ShareAlike 4\.0 International

name: COCONUT (Collection of Open Natural Products)
modality: natural product structures with annotation
description: Aggregated, curated open collection of natural product structures from more than 50 sources, with stereochemistry, organisms, literature and computed properties.
format: SDF, CSV, PostgreSQL dump; REST API

licence.pattern: CC0|Creative Commons.{0,40}Zero

name: Natural Products Atlas
modality: microbial natural product structures with source organisms
description: Curated database of microbially derived natural product structures from the primary literature, with producing organism, isolation reference and chemical ontology terms.
format: TSV, SDF, JSON, GraphML; API

licence.claim: CC-BY-NC-4.0
licence.pattern: licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial 4\.0 International License

notes: Non-commercial.

name: Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD)
modality: curated chemical-gene, chemical-disease and gene-disease relations
description: Manually curated interactions between chemicals, genes, phenotypes, diseases and exposures from the literature, with inferred relations and pathway and Gene Ontology enrichment.
format: CSV, TSV, XML bulk files; batch query

licence.unverified: free for research and education only; commercial use needs permission

name: ClinPGx / PharmGKB
modality: pharmacogenomic annotations (variant, gene, drug)
description: Curated knowledge on how human genetic variation affects drug response: clinical and variant annotations, drug label annotations, dosing guidelines and pathways.
format: TSV, JSON (account needed for bulk downloads); API

licence.claim: CC-BY-SA-4.0
licence.pattern: Attribution-ShareAlike 4\.0

name: DailyMed (structured product labels)
modality: drug labels as structured XML documents
description: Current labelling (package inserts) that companies submit to the FDA for marketed human and animal drugs, as Structured Product Labeling documents, with bulk downloads and web services.
format: SPL XML (zipped); REST web services

licence.claim: NLM web policy: government works may be freely used or reproduced in the U.S.; some content may be copyrighted
licence.pattern: may be freely used or reproduced without permission in the U\.S\.

notes: Label text is written by the manufacturers.

name: European Medicines Agency: medicine data tables
modality: tables of authorised medicines, opinions and referrals
description: Downloadable tables on centrally authorised human and veterinary medicines in the EU: European public assessment reports, orphan designations, paediatric plans, referrals and herbal medicines.
format: XLSX, CSV

licence.claim: EMA legal notice: information may be reproduced when the source is acknowledged
licence.pattern: may be reproduced|reproduction is authorised|reuse

name: Biogen ADME dataset (Fang et al. 2023)
modality: molecules (SMILES) with six in vitro ADME endpoints
description: About 3,500 diverse compounds measured in-house at Biogen for microsomal stability (human, rat), MDR1-MDCK efflux, solubility and plasma protein binding (human, rat), released for model benchmarking.
format: CSV, SDF

name: NCATS ADME data and models
modality: molecules with in vitro ADME assay results
description: Public subsets of NCATS in-house ADME assay data (rat liver microsomal stability, PAMPA permeability, kinetic solubility, CYP inhibition) with trained prediction models.
format: CSV, SDF

name: Broad Drug Repurposing Hub
modality: annotated library of approved and clinical-stage compounds
description: Curated collection of several thousand approved, clinical-trial and pre-clinical tool compounds with mechanism of action, protein targets, disease area, indication and vendor identifiers.
format: TSV

licence.claim: CC BY 4.0 as stated by the Hub, with added limits: no commercial redistribution or marketing use
licence.pattern: made available under the permissive CC-BY 4\.0 license

notes: The Hub names CC BY 4.0 and, on the same page, forbids commercial redistribution and commercial marketing use. Treat it as not cleared for commercial use.

name: Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO)
modality: functional genomics submissions: expression matrices, raw files, sample metadata
description: Public repository for array- and sequence-based functional genomics data: gene expression, methylation, chromatin and single-cell studies, each with platform, sample and series records and curated DataSets.
format: SOFT, MINiML, series matrix TXT, supplementary files (H5, MTX, CSV); E-utilities; FTP

licence.claim: NCBI data usage policy: NCBI places no restrictions on use or distribution; submitters may hold rights
licence.pattern: places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data

notes: Listed as a whole archive. Single studies are not catalogued. E-utilities is disallowed in robots.txt for crawlers, so this catalogue did not call it.

name: Sequence Read Archive (SRA)
modality: raw sequencing reads with run and sample metadata
description: The largest public archive of high-throughput sequencing reads, part of the International Nucleotide Sequence Database Collaboration; also mirrored on AWS and Google Cloud.
format: SRA, FASTQ, BAM; SRA Toolkit; cloud buckets

licence.claim: NCBI data usage policy: NCBI places no restrictions on use or distribution; submitters may hold rights
licence.pattern: places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data

notes: Listed as a whole archive. Single studies are not catalogued. Controlled-access human data (dbGaP) is not part of this entry.

name: European Nucleotide Archive (ENA)
modality: raw reads, assemblies and annotated sequences
description: Europe's archive of nucleotide sequencing data: raw reads, assemblies and annotated sequences with sample and study metadata, exchanged daily with NCBI and DDBJ.
format: FASTQ, BAM, CRAM, FASTA, EMBL flat file; Portal and Browser APIs; FTP and Aspera

licence.claim: INSDC policy: free and unrestricted access, no use restrictions or licensing requirements
licence.pattern: no use restrictions or licensing requirements|free and unrestricted access

notes: Listed as a whole archive. Single studies are not catalogued.

name: BioStudies and the ArrayExpress collection
modality: functional genomics studies: processed and raw files with MAGE-TAB metadata
description: EMBL-EBI's archive of study descriptions and supporting data. Its ArrayExpress collection holds functional genomics experiments (microarray and sequencing) with standardised sample annotation.
format: MAGE-TAB (IDF, SDRF), raw and processed files; REST API; FTP

licence.claim: EMBL-EBI Terms of Use: no restrictions beyond those of the data owner
licence.pattern: no additional restriction|not impose any additional restrictions

notes: Listed as a whole archive. Single studies are not catalogued. Some records carry their own CC0 or CC BY licence.

name: Expression Atlas and Single Cell Expression Atlas
modality: re-analysed baseline and differential expression matrices
description: Curated and uniformly re-analysed gene and protein expression across species, tissues, cell types and conditions: baseline and differential bulk experiments and single-cell experiments with cell type annotation.
format: TSV, R data objects, MTX; FTP

licence.claim: CC-BY-4.0
licence.pattern: Creative Commons Attribution 4\.0|CC[- ]BY[- ]4\.0

name: GTEx (Genotype-Tissue Expression) open-access data
modality: expression matrices, eQTL and sQTL summary tables, sample annotation
description: Gene expression and regulation across more than 50 human tissues from about 1,000 donors: gene and transcript counts and TPM, eQTL and sQTL results and public sample attributes. Genotypes and raw reads are controlled access and not part of this entry.
format: GCT, TSV, Parquet (gzipped) on Google Cloud
notes: The portal's robots.txt disallows every path for unnamed crawlers, so no page of it was read.

name: NCI Genomic Data Commons (TCGA, TARGET, CPTAC and more), open tier
modality: harmonised cancer genomics files and clinical tables
description: Harmonised genomic and clinical data from NCI programmes. The open tier has clinical and biospecimen data, gene expression quantification, masked somatic mutations, copy number segments and slide images. Projects are listed as gdc:* entries.
format: TSV, MAF, BCR XML, SVS; REST API; gdc-client

licence.claim: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GDC open-access tier (no licence stated)
licence.pattern: open and controlled data access adhere to the National Institutes of Health \(NIH\) Genomic Data Sharing Policy

name: ENCODE (Encyclopedia of DNA Elements)
modality: functional genomics tracks, peaks and quantifications
description: Uniformly processed functional genomics experiments in human and mouse: ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, DNase-seq, RNA-seq, Hi-C and more, with candidate cis-regulatory element annotations and rich metadata.
format: FASTQ, BAM, bigWig, bigBed, BED, TSV; REST API; AWS open data bucket

licence.claim: ENCODE data use policy: external users may freely download, analyse and publish without restrictions
licence.pattern: without restrictions

notes: The search API path is disallowed in robots.txt for crawlers, so this catalogue did not call it.

name: Human Cell Atlas Data Portal
modality: single-cell and spatial datasets with standard metadata
description: Community data portal of the Human Cell Atlas: single-cell and single-nucleus transcriptomics and other modalities from healthy human tissues, with raw files, contributor matrices and uniformly processed outputs.
format: FASTQ, BAM, loom, h5ad, MTX; Azul API; Terra export
notes: Listed as a whole portal. Single projects are not catalogued. Some projects are managed access.

name: CZ CELLxGENE Discover and Census
modality: standardised single-cell expression matrices (cells by genes) with cell metadata
description: Curated single-cell datasets in one schema with ontology-based cell metadata, and the Census: all the data as one queryable corpus of tens of millions of cells for Python and R.
format: h5ad (AnnData), Seurat RDS, TileDB-SOMA (Census); Discover and Census APIs

licence.claim: CC-BY-4.0
licence.pattern: CC[- ]BY 4\.0|CC-BY-4\.0|Creative Commons Attribution 4\.0

notes: Listed as a whole resource. Single collections are not catalogued.

name: LINCS (Library of Integrated Network-based Cellular Signatures)
modality: perturbation signatures: L1000 expression, proteomics, imaging, viability
description: NIH programme that profiled human cells after chemical and genetic perturbation. The L1000 Connectivity Map has over a million expression signatures; other centres added phosphoproteomics, imaging and cell viability.
format: GCTx, TSV, HDF5; clue.io, iLINCS and SigCom LINCS portals
notes: The programme site lincsproject.org no longer answers and clue.io disallows scripts; the landing page here is the SigCom LINCS portal.

name: recount3
modality: uniformly processed RNA-seq coverage and count matrices
description: Uniformly processed gene, exon and exon-exon junction counts and base-level coverage for over 750,000 public human and mouse RNA-seq samples from SRA, GTEx and TCGA, with an R/Bioconductor interface.
format: RangedSummarizedExperiment (R), bigWig, TSV; AWS open data bucket

name: ARCHS4
modality: uniformly aligned RNA-seq gene and transcript count matrices
description: Gene- and transcript-level counts for most public human and mouse RNA-seq samples from GEO and SRA, aligned with one pipeline and shipped as large HDF5 matrices with sample metadata.
format: HDF5 (H5)

licence.claim: CC BY 4.0 as stated by ARCHS4, limited on the same page to non-commercial use (commercial use needs a licence)
licence.pattern: free to use for non-commercial purposes

notes: The help page names CC BY 4.0 for the expression files and, in the next sentence, limits free use to non-commercial purposes.

name: Ensembl
modality: genome assemblies, gene annotation, variation and comparative genomics
description: Genome browser and annotation for vertebrates and model organisms: gene builds, transcripts, regulatory features, variants with consequences, orthologues and alignments, with BioMart, VEP and FTP dumps.
format: FASTA, GTF, GFF3, VCF, MySQL dumps; REST API

licence.claim: Ensembl: no restrictions on access to or use of the data
licence.pattern: imposes no restrictions on access to, or use of, the data|no restrictions on (the )?(access to, or )?use of

name: GENCODE
modality: reference gene annotation for human and mouse
description: The reference gene annotation for the human and mouse genomes used by ENCODE, GTEx and most RNA-seq pipelines: protein-coding genes, lncRNAs, pseudogenes and small RNAs with transcript models.
format: GTF, GFF3, FASTA

licence.claim: GENCODE: all project data is open access (no licence named)
licence.pattern: GENCODE project data is open access

name: UCSC Genome Browser database
modality: genome assemblies and annotation tracks
description: Reference assemblies and thousands of annotation tracks (genes, conservation, regulation, variation, repeats) for many species, with table downloads, a public MySQL server and a REST API.
format: 2bit, FASTA, BED, bigBed, bigWig, MySQL tables; REST API

name: 1000 Genomes Project (IGSR)
modality: whole-genome sequences and phased variant calls from 26 populations
description: Open catalogue of human genetic variation from 2,504 individuals (3,202 in the high-coverage resequencing), maintained with later collections by the International Genome Sample Resource.
format: CRAM, VCF, FASTQ; FTP, AWS and Globus

licence.claim: IGSR: 1000 Genomes data are available without embargo or restriction on use
licence.pattern: without embargo|publicly available without

citation.title_has: global reference for human genetic variation

name: gnomAD (Genome Aggregation Database)
modality: allele frequencies and constraint metrics from aggregated exomes and genomes
description: Harmonised exome and genome sequencing data from hundreds of thousands of people: variant sites with population allele frequencies, quality annotations, structural variants and gene constraint scores.
format: VCF, Hail Tables, TSV; on Google Cloud, AWS and Azure
notes: The gnomAD site is a script-driven page that this script cannot read; the licence is the one Bioregistry lists.

name: ClinVar
modality: variant - condition assertions with review status
description: Public archive of reports on the relationship between human variants and conditions, with clinical significance, supporting evidence and review status from submitting laboratories and expert panels.
format: VCF, XML, TSV; E-utilities; FTP

licence.claim: NCBI data usage policy: NCBI places no restrictions on use or distribution; submitters may hold rights
licence.pattern: places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data

name: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog
modality: curated SNP-trait associations and full summary statistics
description: Curated collection of published genome-wide association studies: study descriptions, significant variant-trait associations mapped to ontology terms, and deposited full summary statistics.
format: TSV, OWL/RDF; REST API; FTP

licence.pattern: CC0

name: JASPAR
modality: transcription factor binding profiles (position frequency matrices)
description: Open-access database of curated, non-redundant transcription factor binding profiles for eukaryotes, with genome-wide predicted binding site tracks.
format: JASPAR, MEME and TRANSFAC matrix formats, BED tracks; REST API

licence.claim: CC-BY-4.0
licence.pattern: Creative Commons Attribution 4\.0|CC[- ]BY[- ]4\.0

name: MSigDB (Molecular Signatures Database)
modality: annotated gene sets
description: Tens of thousands of annotated gene sets for enrichment analysis in human and mouse: hallmark sets, curated pathways, regulatory targets, ontology sets, oncogenic and immunologic signatures and cell type signatures.
format: GMT, JSON, XML, SQLite

licence.claim: CC-BY-4.0
licence.pattern: Creative Commons Attribution 4\.0

notes: Download needs a free account. Some sub-collections (for example those derived from KEGG or BioCarta) have their own terms.

name: cBioPortal public datasets (datahub)
modality: per-study mutation, copy number, expression and clinical tables
description: Curated, analysis-ready tables from published cancer genomics studies and from TCGA: mutations, copy number, expression, methylation and clinical attributes in one file layout.
format: tab-delimited study files (MAF and matrices); REST API

licence.claim: ODbL-1.0
licence.pattern: data in cBioPortal are available under the ODC Open Database License

notes: Listed as a whole collection. Single studies are not catalogued. The FAQ says some studies have other terms.

name: eQTL Catalogue
modality: uniformly processed QTL summary statistics
description: Uniformly processed gene expression and splicing QTL summary statistics from many public studies across human tissues and cell types, with fine-mapping credible sets.
format: TSV (tabix-indexed), Parquet; REST API; FTP

licence.claim: CC-BY-4.0
licence.pattern: Creative Commons Attribution 4\.0|CC[- ]BY[- ]4\.0

name: PRIDE Archive
modality: mass spectrometry proteomics submissions: raw files, identifications, quantification
description: The largest public repository of mass spectrometry proteomics data and a founding member of ProteomeXchange: raw spectra, search results and study metadata.
format: RAW, mzML, mzIdentML, mzTab; REST API; FTP and Aspera

licence.claim: EMBL-EBI Terms of Use: no restrictions beyond those of the data owner
licence.pattern: no additional restriction|not impose any additional restrictions

notes: Listed as a whole archive. Single projects are not catalogued. PRIDE's own licence page is script-driven and was not read; PRIDE is reported to release new submissions under CC0.

name: MassIVE
modality: mass spectrometry submissions and reanalyses
description: Community repository of mass spectrometry data at UC San Diego and a ProteomeXchange member, with the MassIVE-KB spectral library and links to GNPS for metabolomics.
format: RAW, mzML, mzXML, MGF; FTP
notes: Listed as a whole archive. Single submissions are not catalogued.

name: MetaboLights
modality: metabolomics studies: raw spectra, metabolite assignments, ISA-Tab metadata
description: Open repository for metabolomics experiments and derived information: NMR and mass spectrometry raw data, identified metabolites and study design.
format: ISA-Tab, mzML, nmrML, vendor raw formats; REST API; FTP

licence.claim: EMBL-EBI Terms of Use: no restrictions beyond those of the data owner
licence.pattern: no additional restriction|not impose any additional restrictions

notes: Listed as a whole archive. Single studies are not catalogued.

name: Metabolomics Workbench
modality: metabolomics studies with raw and processed data, metabolite structures
description: US national repository for metabolomics data (NIH Common Fund): studies with raw and processed measurements, protocols, a metabolite structure database and RefMet nomenclature.
format: mwTab, mzML, vendor raw formats; REST API
notes: The site's robots.txt disallows every path for crawlers, so no page of it was read.

name: Human Metabolome Database (HMDB)
modality: metabolite records with spectra, concentrations and pathways
description: Detailed records of small-molecule metabolites found in the human body: chemical data, reference spectra, normal and abnormal concentrations, disease links, enzymes and pathways.
format: XML, SDF, FASTA, spectra files
notes: Commercial use needs explicit permission from the HMDB team.

name: Human Protein Atlas
modality: protein and RNA expression tables and immunohistochemistry images
description: Maps of human proteins in tissues, single cell types, cell lines, blood, brain and tumours from antibody-based imaging and transcriptomics, with downloadable expression tables per gene.
format: TSV (zipped), XML, RDF, images

claims.pattern: licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4\.0
licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3\.0
licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4\.0 International License for all copyrightable parts

notes: Earlier versions of the atlas were CC BY-SA; the licence is read from the licence page on every run. The page adds that some data are subject to third-party constraints.

name: UniProt (UniProtKB, UniRef, UniParc, Proteomes)
modality: protein sequences with functional annotation
description: The reference resource for protein sequence and function: reviewed Swiss-Prot and unreviewed TrEMBL entries, UniRef clusters, the UniParc archive and reference proteomes, with cross-references to hundreds of databases.
